On our right just OUTSIDE the exit a BLUE SQUARE sign with WHITE TUNNEL ARCH pictogram crossed by a RED DIAGONAL rising bottom-left to top-right, precisely C112 from supplied reference. The icon is a rounded masonry tunnel arch, never a motorway overpass symbol. No other signs, no text overlay, realistic daylight exposure.
proposal.novelty_review: Existing C111 teaches tunnel entry and dipped headlights; C208 teaches end of motorway. This is a dedicated C112 tunnel-exit interpretation with continuing ordinary driving rules.

fr.question_text: Quelle indication donne ce panneau à la sortie de l’ouvrage ?
fr.answer_a: La fin du tunnel et des prescriptions propres à son entrée.
fr.explanation: Le panneau C112 signale la sortie du tunnel et la fin des prescriptions liées au panneau d’entrée C111. Les autres règles restent applicables : je garde une allure adaptée et utilise l’éclairage nécessaire aux conditions rencontrées à l’extérieur.

en.question_text: What does this sign indicate as I leave the structure?
en.answer_a: The end of the tunnel and of the requirements associated with its entrance.
en.answer_d: A prohibition on driving a car.
en.explanation: Sign C112 marks the tunnel exit and the end of the requirements associated with entry sign C111. Other rules still apply: I keep an appropriate speed and use the lights needed for the conditions outside.

review_note: Actual image reviewed: square blue tunnel arch crossed by ascending red bar placed at a real tunnel exit into daylight. No motorway-end symbol. Both languages identify the end of tunnel-specific requirements while preserving other speed and lighting obligations; answer A only.
